what: hand-written tabular agents on the single-drive expected-points problem; regret is exact (policy evaluation by a linear solve), in expected points per drive start

environment.step: one fourth-down decision (downs 1 to 3 are played inside the environment)

dp_cost.method: value iteration on the stage 1 model (mdp_drive.solve_drive)
dp_cost.note: DP reads the transition probabilities; the learners only see sampled outcomes, one decision per step

reinforce.note: regret is of the stochastic softmax policy itself; 'greedy' is of its argmax

reinforce_no_baseline.note: regret is of the stochastic softmax policy itself; 'greedy' is of its argmax

stamp.what: solved game model (components plus count, mode and coach tables)

dynamic_kickoff_2024.reason: rule constant; no data under this rule exists before the season

dynamic_kickoff_2025.reason: rule constant; no data under this rule exists before the season

stamp.note: the only test-season content is the components' kickoff rule tables; the solved game uses the latest rule's table for every kickoff

note_on_time: runs execute in `workers` parallel processes on a shared machine; the wall time of a full run is about the sum over runs divided by the number of workers
